testMethod.axe: Check image-alt, input-image-alt, role-img-alt, svg-img-alt, object-alt, area-alt rules for missing or empty alt attributes.
testMethod.sr: FIND_NEXT_IMAGE loop — verify each image announcement is meaningful, not placeholder text ('image', 'photo', 'untitled') or redundant with surrounding text.

testMethod.screenshot: Identify audio-only or video-only content on the page. Check for a text transcript link near audio content or a text/audio alternative near video-only content.

testMethod.axe: Check video-caption rule for missing <track> elements.
testMethod.screenshot: If video is present, verify caption track exists visually. Cannot verify caption accuracy or sync automatically.
If video is present, check for audio description track or full text alternative link.

testMethod.axe: Check structural markup rules: list nesting, table headers, ARIA parent/child, definition lists, fake headings.
testMethod.sr: FIND_NEXT_HEADING loop — verify heading hierarchy (no skipped levels). FIND_NEXT_LANDMARK loop — verify landmark structure. Navigate tables — check header associations are announced. Tab through form fields — verify labels are associated.
GO_TO_BEGINNING then walk entire page with next commands. Review transcript for logical reading order — does the sequence match the visual layout intent?

testMethod.screenshot: Look for instructions that rely solely on shape, color, size, visual location, or orientation (e.g., 'click the round button', 'see the sidebar', 'the red text').

testMethod.axe: Check link-in-text-block rule for links distinguishable only by color.
testMethod.screenshot: Scan for color-only information: status indicators (green/red), error states, required field markers, chart/graph data. Each must have a non-color alternative (text label, icon, pattern).

testMethod.sr: Check if audio plays automatically on page load. If it plays for >3 seconds, verify there's a mechanism to pause/stop or control volume. Use sr to find audio controls.

testMethod.axe: Check frame-focusable-content and scrollable-region-focusable rules.
testMethod.sr: Tab through entire page. Verify all interactive elements are reachable and operable via keyboard. Test custom widgets with expected patterns (arrows for tabs/menus, Space/Enter for buttons, Escape for dialogs).
Tab through entire page including into modals, embedded content, and custom widgets. Verify you can always Tab or Escape out. Check iframes and media players especially.

testMethod.axe: Check accesskeys rule for HTML accesskey attribute issues.
testMethod.sr: Test for JS-based single-character shortcuts (/, j, k, ?, etc.) by pressing letter keys without modifiers. If shortcuts exist, verify they can be turned off, remapped, or are only active when the relevant component has focus.

testMethod.axe: Check meta-refresh rule.
testMethod.screenshot: Look for session timeout warnings, auto-advancing content, or time-limited interactions. User must be able to turn off, adjust, or extend.

testMethod.axe: Check blink and marquee rules.
testMethod.screenshot: Look for auto-updating content, animations, carousels, or moving content lasting >5 seconds. Must have pause/stop/hide mechanism.
Look for flashing or rapidly changing content. No content should flash more than 3 times per second unless below general flash and red flash thresholds.

testMethod.axe: Check bypass rule for skip nav or landmark structure.
testMethod.sr: Tab first from page top — is there a skip-to-content link? FIND_NEXT_LANDMARK loop — verify landmark regions provide bypass.

testMethod.axe: Check document-title rule for presence and non-empty title.
testMethod.sr: Verify the page title announced by the screen reader is descriptive and identifies the page purpose — not just generic text like 'Home' or 'Untitled'.

testMethod.axe: Check tabindex rule for positive tabindex values.
testMethod.sr: Tab through page — verify focus order matches logical reading/visual order. Check modals trap focus, dynamic content doesn't break order.
testMethod.screenshot: Take screenshots while tabbing to verify visual focus position matches expected logical order.

testMethod.axe: Check link-name rule for empty or missing link text.
testMethod.sr: FIND_NEXT_LINK loop — check each link's announced text is meaningful in context. Flag 'click here', 'read more', 'learn more' without surrounding context.

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.note: Requires touch/pointer testing not available in our tooling.

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.note: Requires pointer event testing not available in our tooling.

testMethod.axe: Check label-content-name-mismatch rule.
testMethod.sr: For each interactive element, check that the accessible name announced contains the visible text label.
testMethod.screenshot: Cross-reference visible label text against SR announcements to catch mismatches.

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.note: Requires device motion testing not available in our tooling.

testMethod.axe: Check html-has-lang and html-lang-valid rules for presence and validity of lang attribute on <html>.

testMethod.sr: Tab through all interactive elements. Verify that receiving focus alone does not trigger a change of context (page navigation, form submission, focus move, significant content change).
Change values in form controls (select dropdowns, checkboxes, radio buttons, text fields). Verify no unexpected context changes unless user is advised beforehand.

criteria.name: Consistent Help
criteria.note: Requires multi-page comparison. Cannot be evaluated from a single page.

testMethod.sr: Submit forms with invalid/empty data. Are errors announced? Tab to errored fields — does SR announce the error text? Are error messages associated with the relevant fields?

testMethod.axe: Check form-field-multiple-labels rule.
testMethod.sr: Tab through form fields — each input should announce its label. Check that required fields, expected formats, and constraints are communicated.

criteria.name: Redundant Entry
criteria.note: Requires multi-step process testing. Cannot be evaluated from a single page.

testMethod.axe: Check all ARIA rules: allowed/required/prohibited attributes, valid roles, valid values, missing names for buttons/inputs/selects.
testMethod.sr: Navigate to custom widgets. Verify role is announced (e.g., 'button', 'checkbox', 'tab'). Activate and check state changes are announced (expanded/collapsed, checked/unchecked, selected). Check dialogs announce name and role on open.

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.note: Requires live media content. Cannot be tested with static pages.

testMethod.screenshot: If video is present, check for audio description track or alternative. Cannot verify description quality automatically.
Resize viewport to portrait and landscape dimensions. Verify content works in both orientations and is not locked to one.

testMethod.axe: Check autocomplete-valid rule for incorrectly formatted autocomplete attributes.
testMethod.screenshot: Inspect form fields in the DOM for common user info inputs (name, email, phone, address, credit card) that are missing autocomplete attributes entirely — axe only validates attributes that exist, it won't flag missing ones.

testMethod.axe: Check color-contrast rule. Review 'incomplete' items — these are cases axe couldn't compute (gradients, images, transparency).
testMethod.screenshot: For axe incomplete items, visually inspect text on complex backgrounds. Check text on images, gradients, or dynamic backgrounds. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.

testMethod.axe: Check meta-viewport rule for user-scalable=no or maximum-scale < 2.
testMethod.screenshot: Zoom to 200% and screenshot. Verify text is readable, not clipped, and functionality is preserved.
Check that text is rendered as actual text, not images. Inspect DOM to confirm text elements are real text nodes. Exceptions: logos, decorative text where presentation is essential.
Resize viewport to 320px width. Screenshot and verify no horizontal scrolling, no content clipping, no overlapping. Exceptions: maps, diagrams, data tables, toolbars.
Inspect UI components (form field borders, buttons, icons) and graphical objects. Need 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors. Check focus indicators, custom checkboxes, icon buttons, chart elements.

testMethod.axe: Check avoid-inline-spacing rule for inline styles that override user text spacing.
testMethod.screenshot: Inject WCAG text spacing overrides (line-height 1.5, letter-spacing 0.12em, word-spacing 0.16em, paragraph spacing 2em) and screenshot. Check for content loss, clipping, or overlap.

testMethod.sr: Tab to elements with hover/focus content. Press Escape — is content dismissible? Check focus behavior.
testMethod.screenshot: Hover over trigger elements and screenshot. Verify popup is visible, hoverable (can mouse into it), and persists until dismissed.

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.note: Requires multi-page comparison. Cannot be evaluated from a single page.

testMethod.axe: Check empty-heading rule.
testMethod.sr: FIND_NEXT_HEADING loop — verify each heading is descriptive and meaningful. Tab through form fields — check labels are clear and describe expected input.
Tab through all interactive elements to move focus.
testMethod.screenshot: Take screenshots at each focused element. Verify every focused element has a visible focus indicator distinguishable from the unfocused state.

testMethod.sr: Tab through interactive elements to move focus.
testMethod.screenshot: Screenshot at each stop with sticky headers/footers, cookie banners, or floating UI present. Verify the focused element is not fully hidden behind overlapping content.

criteria.name: Dragging Movements
criteria.note: Requires pointer/drag interaction testing not available in our tooling.

testMethod.axe: Check target-size rule for interactive targets smaller than 24x24 CSS pixels.
testMethod.screenshot: Visually verify target sizes and spacing for elements axe flags as incomplete. Exceptions: inline text links, user-agent-controlled elements.

testMethod.axe: Check valid-lang rule for invalid lang attribute values on existing elements.
testMethod.screenshot: Scan page content for text in a different language from the page default. Check the DOM for whether those sections have lang attributes — axe only validates existing attributes, it won't discover foreign-language content missing a lang wrapper.

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.note: Requires multi-page comparison. Cannot be evaluated from a single page.

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.note: Requires multi-page comparison. Cannot be evaluated from a single page.

testMethod.sr: Trigger form errors by submitting invalid data. Check that error messages suggest how to fix the problem (not just 'invalid input' but 'enter a valid email address'). Verify error suggestions are announced by SR.
For forms that submit legal/financial/data changes, check for confirmation step or review page. Verify SR announces confirmation dialogs and undo options.
testMethod.screenshot: Verify visual presence of review/confirmation step before final submission.
If authentication is present, check that it doesn't require cognitive function tests (puzzles, memorizing passwords) unless an alternative is provided or it's object/content recognition.

testMethod.axe: Check for appropriate use of ARIA live regions, role=status, role=alert.
testMethod.sr: Trigger status messages (form success, search results count, error banners, loading indicators). Verify they are announced without focus moving. Check for role=status, role=alert, aria-live regions in DOM.
